description: Enhanced Open Graph coverage: all basic properties (type, title, description, url) set together; description with an injection payload to verify escaping in the og:description content; a site_name property alongside the emitted defaults; a typed article with multiple structured attributes (published_time plus a tag list); and a bare type with only the defaults following.
